title: epan: convert dissectors I to C99 types

notes.body: wtx is expected to be uint32 as key on line 1200, but this code will only give 0 or 1. seems like faulty code for a key..

added 8 commits
  • 03191371...eeb129b4 - 7 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 8dda8c25 - epan: convert dissectors I to C99 types
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16457/diffs?diff_id=1066658184&start_sha=031913715c56462938675dfedd790aa9c1753231)

+ * IEEE80211_RADIOTAP_DB_TX_ATTENUATION uint16_t      decibels (dB)
  *

  *      set at factory calibration.  0 is max power.  Monotonically
